Background humanistic context only: Jing-Zhang railway opened 1909, designed by Zhan Tianyou with a switchback (人字形) line at Qinglongqiao; the former alignment is being reused as the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park (Haidian section). Background-only; not used for any spatial boundary, metric, or formal planning conclusion.

Language and structure reference for executable clauses (who/for-whom/threshold/resource/check). Also grounds Haidian district context (two-zone construction, sci-tech innovation center). Not used as spatial/metric evidence.

Real Haidian 3-year action plan (Hai Min Fa [2026] No.5) modeling district-level 'district-coordinates / street-executes / community-lands' three-tier collection and '3 pilot smart senior communities per year' delivery pattern. Reference for grounded, site-specific service delivery language.

Haidian OPC entrepreneurship ecology (draft for comment). Cited by community Issue #1061 as a model of concrete, accountable policy language (applicable objects, thresholds, lead departments). Background language reference.
Haidian building green-development implementation plan (draft for comment). Background language reference for thresholds, responsible departments and inspection ratios per Issue #1061.

Background conceptual grounding only: Marx (Theses on Feuerbach - philosophers have only interpreted the world; alienated labour), Mumford (The City in History - city as container/magnet for human association), Jacobs (The Death and Life of Great American Cities - streets for people), Lefebvre (The Production of Space). Philosophical spine for 'AI-and-people / human-centered'; not a spatial, metric or regulatory authority.

Tsinghua-MIT viewpoint in Nature Computational Science: LLM-driven urban planning framework as 'intelligent planning assistant', human-AI closed loop (conceptualization-generation-evaluation). Backs the 'AI serves people, not replaces' thesis; academic, not a spatial authority.

Yin Zhi (THU professor, expert解读 Central Urban Work Conference): 'people-centered livable city', 'from rent-driven to people-city model'. Authoritative people-centered urbanism grounding for the AI-and-people spine.

Jiang Hongfeng (Marxist political-economy): digital labour alienation ('seeing objects not people'), 'labour-life-city' synergy, 'free all-round development of people'. Contemporary Marxist grounding for the alienation-labour thread in the theoretical spine.

Shanghai Yangpu District 15th Five-Year planning: 'two axes, two zones, one center, one island' innovation spatial pattern; 'people build the people's city'; complete communities. Real Shanghai district-planning sample for comparative governance-language reference.

Beijing AI Origin Community (OPC) real operations: 1000+ AI scientists, 13k developers, 400+ firms (74% AI), Origin Tower opened 2026-03, OPC (one-person-company) concept. Empirical anchor for PROV-KEY-002; also reveals the submission's provisional rectangle is NOT yet anchored to the real OPC footprint - requires honest offset note.
Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park: about 9 km along the old railway, being built as a heritage park. Real heritage-park fact underpinning the ground-stitching belt and cultural anchor.
Beijing 14th Five-Year urban renewal action: stock-quality-improvement, micro-renewal leverages big livelihood. Context for renewal-vs-greenfield framing of the design scope.
